title: Aktif iceriklerim ozeti
purpose: HomeActiveContentListScreen. Shows max 3 active content cards each with progress %, type label (Yolculuk/Atolye/e-Kitap), Devam Et button (AC-FR-E2-06-01). Tumunu Gor navigates to Library (AC-FR-E2-06-02). Locked items show Kilitli chip (AC-FR-E2-06-03).

loading.description: Three card skeletons (height 96) stacked vertically with shimmer.

ready.description: Max 3 cards: each shows content type chip (Yolculuk/Atolye/e-Kitap, color-coded), title, subtitle (chapter/duration), progress bar + % label, Devam Et button. Locked card shows Kilitli chip and disabled Devam Et. Tumunu Gor link at section bottom. AC-FR-E2-06-01/02/03 satisfied.

empty.description: 'Aktif icerik yok' with compass icon and 'Kesfe Git' CTA. No active items in progress.

error.description: 'Aktif icerikler yuklenemedi. Tekrar Dene' inline error card.

offline.description: Cached active content list shown. Devam Et enabled only for locally cached content. Non-cached items show 'Cevrimdisi yuklenemiyor' subtitle.
